intent: Sum available-today units of the specific Stanley FM 39X-HFQ parts-case Gray 25 l Storage Bin/Organizer across every Graz PowerTool store (including 0-availability stores) and report as "%d total".
success_criteria: Exactly one product_sku resolved matching brand=Stanley, series=Professional, model=FM 39X-HFQ with storage_type='parts case', color_family='Gray', volume=25 l
All stores with city='Graz' enumerated, including those with no store_inventory row (treated as 0 available)
Total = SUM(COALESCE(available_today_quantity,0)) over every Graz store for that SKU
refs include record_path of EVERY Graz store plus the product record_path

args.stdin:
WITH target AS (
  SELECT pv.product_sku, pv.record_path AS product_path
  FROM product_variants pv
  JOIN product_kinds pk ON pk.product_kind_id = pv.product_kind_id AND pk.product_kind_name = :kind_name
  JOIN product_variant_properties s ON s.product_sku = pv.product_sku AND s.property_key = 'storage_type' AND s.property_value_text = :storage_type
  JOIN product_variant_properties c ON c.product_sku = pv.product_sku AND c.property_key = 'color_family' AND c.property_value_text = :color_family
  JOIN product_variant_properties v ON v.product_sku = pv.product_sku AND v.property_key = 'volume_l' AND v.property_value_number = :volume_l
  WHERE pv.brand = :brand AND pv.series = :series AND pv.model = :model
)
SELECT st.store_id,
       st.record_path AS store_path,
       t.product_sku,
       t.product_path,
       COALESCE(inv.available_today_quantity, 0) AS available_today,
       SUM(COALESCE(inv.available_today_quantity, 0)) OVER () AS total_available
FROM stores st
CROSS JOIN target t
LEFT JOIN store_inventory inv ON inv.store_id = st.store_id AND inv.product_sku = t.product_sku
WHERE st.city = :city
ORDER BY st.store_id;

agents_md_constraints.rule: When responding with reference - provide full path in the repo to the object.
When answering availability questions - answer should reference products that are available, but should not reference unavailable products. Same with stores.
Note that inventory lives only in SQL projections

answer_template.message: {total_available} total — across all Graz PowerTool branches (including 0-availability branches), {total_available} unit(s) of the Stanley Professional FM 39X-HFQ Storage Bin and Organizer (parts case, Gray, 25 l) are available today.
